steps.what: Provide individual wellness or nutrition support through listening, discussion and appropriate referral

tasks.design: Keep individual support with the coordinator, using approved guidance in {DOCS}. The person listens, adapts advice within their professional scope and refers concerns through the existing process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support depends on personal circumstances and trust.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance can support the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Understand the concern and recognize the limits of general wellness support.
tasks.human_edge: Listen carefully and respond with contextual judgement.
tasks.altitude: Own useful individual support and appropriate referral.

evidence.claim: Individual wellness support retains full human conversation time in this design.

assumptions: The baseline is participant support, not an invented administrative reporting workload.
Existing document guidance suffices; no new automation or upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Is there a distinct repetitive record workload outside the support conversation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Listening, contextual advice and referral remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage wellness digital information and webinars

steps.what: Prepare verified program content and required database or publication updates
Format Web pages and newsletters from the verified content using native templates
Check and publish digital updates, maintain databases and provide live webinars

tasks.design: Configure native {CMS} and {MARKETING_AUTOMATION} templates to format verified content rather than copying layout repeatedly. The coordinator checks previews and recipients before publishing, maintains non-template database changes and delivers webinars through the existing meeting facilities linked from {CALENDAR}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layout work can coexist with manual publishing and live delivery.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reproduce approved structure from captured content fields.
tasks.still_hard: Verify current program facts, accessible presentation and appropriate recipients.
tasks.human_edge: Choose correct information and handle live audience questions.
tasks.altitude: Own accurate digital information across channels.

evidence.claim: Configured publication templates can format captured content without replacing editorial checks or webinars; the time effect is unmeasured.

assumptions: The coordinator produces title, body, program date, price, access details, source version, links, intended channel and recipient-list reference in s1; its 30 hours includes capture and verification.
No list of recipients is inferred from health data; the coordinator validates the permitted list during s3.
Missing content or failed previews return to manual editing and publishing.
Use native templates before cross-channel custom code.
Five focal and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover template testing, accessibility and access support.
Webinar material preparation remains human within s1 and live delivery remains within s3; no webinar time is saved by formatting web content.
unknowns: Actual mix of layout work, database maintenance and live webinars
research_questions: What share of observed workload is repeated layout that native templates can actually remove?

already_counted.description: Verified content capture and material preparation
Preview checks, publishing, database work and webinars

approvals.approved_version: Exact page or newsletter preview, links, source version, destination and recipient list; any change invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 5 focal upkeep gives central net 20%. Range 0-15% allows limited layout share and corrections; existing templates or predominantly webinar work yield zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Respond to wellness program information requests

steps.what: Read information requests and locate verified wellness program facts
Draft a source-linked response about the requested wellness program or service

loop.purpose: Draft a reply from verified program information
loop.input: Request brief, permitted facts and source version
loop.output: Draft answer with source links and unresolved questions
loop.check: Coordinator verifies that it answers the actual question without adding health advice or unsupported promises
loop.stop: One revision; personal health, media-sensitive or unsupported questions revert to a human response
loop.why_not_simpler: Natural-language questions require contextual wording; fixed snippets remain the first choice for exact repeats

steps.what: Approve and respond to the requester, handling sensitive or complex questions personally

tasks.design: Use native reply snippets in {EMAIL} first and bounded drafting against verified {DOCS} only for suitable wording variations. The coordinator checks meaning and approves the exact response; sensitive media and personal health questions stay with a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated questions vary in wording while program facts change.
tasks.enabler_now: A limited source-bound assistant can prepare drafts for review.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize when a factual inquiry is actually a health or reputational concern.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret intent and handle sensitive questions.

evidence.claim: Source-bound reply drafting can assist routine wording while contextual and sensitive requests retain human handling; this design is unmeasured.

assumptions: The coordinator produces question scope, recipient, permitted program facts, source version and unresolved issues in s1; its 30 hours includes reading, source lookup and capture.
Current program content is maintained by the separate digital-information task; no free new knowledge-base author is assumed.
Missing facts or uncertain disclosure scope stop the assistant and return to manual handling.
Draft correction is included in s2 and final sending or conversation in s3.
Five extra focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover snippet and source-link upkeep.
research_questions: Do checked drafts beat existing snippets after source lookup and review time are counted?

already_counted.description: Request reading, source lookup and capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact reply text, sources, recipient and disclosure scope; changes require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91.25; gross 8.75 minus 5 upkeep gives central net 3.75%. Range 0-2% allows complex requests and source checking; personal conversations retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Organize program resources and agree owners, dates and dependencies with providers
Notify internal action owners of recorded wellness program deadlines
Oversee program readiness and delivery, resolving provider and participant concerns

tasks.design: Configure internal due-date reminders in the existing {PROJECT} action plan and {EMAIL}. The coordinator still obtains provider confirmations, checks readiness and oversees delivery; reminders never certify clinical eligibility or instructor qualifications.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine internal chasing competes with substantive program coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project reminders can use agreed action dates and owners.
tasks.still_hard: Confirm actual readiness and respond when arrangements change.
tasks.human_edge: Coordinate people and assess whether the event can proceed.
tasks.altitude: Own readiness and program delivery rather than repeated deadline reminders.

evidence.claim: Native project reminders can replace repeated deadline messages; they do not replace provider confirmation or delivery oversight.

assumptions: The coordinator produces action ID, named internal owner, confirmed due date, dependency, provider confirmation reference and reminder schedule in s1; its 35 hours includes consultation and capture.
Providers supply availability and readiness updates through the current process; the coordinator obtains and evaluates them in s1 or s3, without assuming automatic status fields.
Missing owners, changed dates or uncertain confirmations return to manual coordination.
Use native project reminders before custom workflow code; no new public messaging or medical decision is automated.
Five extra focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover plan updates and reminder exceptions.
Clinical delivery and participant eligibility remain with the existing qualified providers; no transfer or saving is claimed for that work.
research_questions: Can reminders remove routine chasing without increasing false readiness assumptions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross 15 minus 5 upkeep gives central net 10%. Range 0-8% allows date changes and manual follow-up; provider coordination and live oversight retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own participant trust, accurate public information and dependable program readiness.
reach: Support recreation managers with readiness planning
Support service managers with clear participant information
role.ambitious_version: A wellness coordinator who uses native publication templates and reminders while preserving individual support, live teaching and meaningful readiness checks.
